d: Short-cropped, ash-brown hair with choppy bangs and a small ponytail at the nape of the neck. Sharp, amethyst-purple eyes with a determined expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a black pleated mini-skirt, a black sleeveless top with a red ribbon bow at the chest, and an oversized white and coral-red hooded jacket draped over the shoulders. The look is completed with black thigh-high stockings, black shoes, black fingerless gloves, and a black utility belt with a small pouch on the left thigh, while holding a curved black sword.
